moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: Cricket's fast-paced The Hundred tournament culminates with both the men's and women's finals at Lord's on Sunday.

angles.name: Finals Fever
angles.copy: Who's lifting the trophy? The Hundred Finals Day is set to electrify Lord's this Sunday with both the men's and women's champions crowned!

angles.name: Lord's Showdown
angles.copy: All roads lead to Lord's! The pinnacle of The Hundred is this weekend, promising a thrilling day of cricket action.

angles.name: Women's Cricket Spotlight
angles.copy: History in the making! The Hundred Women's Final is a huge moment for the sport, showcasing incredible talent on the big stage.

moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new EFL Championship season begins on Friday evening with Wolves hosting Blackburn Rovers, marking the start of a 46-game campaign.

angles.name: New Season Hype
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The EFL Championship kicks off this Friday night. Who are you backing for promotion this season?

angles.name: Wolves vs Blackburn
angles.copy: Friday night lights! Wolves vs Blackburn gets the Championship season underway. Big three points up for grabs from the off.

angles.name: Wrexham's Return
angles.copy: Welcome to the Championship, Wrexham! After back-to-back promotions, the Red Dragons begin their journey in the second tier this weekend.

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated 10-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena this Saturday.

angles.name: Ariana Takes Over
angles.copy: London, get ready! Ariana Grande kicks off her massive 10-night residency at The O2 this weekend. Who's got tickets to the 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

angles.name: Pop Event of the Summer
angles.copy: The pop event of the summer is here! Ariana Grande's O2 shows are going to be absolutely epic. Expect hits, visuals, and pure pop magic.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting Thursday.

angles.name: Wembley Goes After Hours
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley Stadium starting Thursday! Five nights of the 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour – get ready, London!

angles.name: R&B Stadium King
angles.copy: Abel Tesfaye returns to Wembley! The biggest R&B stadium tour in music history is here. What's your must-hear Weeknd track live?

moments.title: Boomtown Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The immersive, theatrical Boomtown Fair festival in Hampshire runs from August 12-16, bringing its unique blend of music, art, and storytelling.

angles.name: Welcome to Boomtown
angles.copy: Chapter 1: The Gathering is underway! Boomtown Fair opens its gates in Hampshire this week for another incredible, immersive experience.

angles.name: Beyond the Music
angles.copy: It's more than just a festival, it's a whole world! Boomtown is buzzing with its unique blend of music, art, and theatrical escapism this week.

moments.title: Summer Nights at Kelvingrove Bandstand
moments.blurb: Glasgow's Summer Nights at the Bandstand festival continues this week with performances from artists including John Grant, ABC, The Wombats, Idlewild, and Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Glasgow's Gigs
angles.copy: Summer Nights at the Bandstand continues in Glasgow this week! John Grant, ABC, The Wombats, Idlewild, and Billy Ocean are all playing. Who are you seeing?

angles.name: Iconic Artists in Glasgow
angles.copy: From ABC to Billy Ocean, Kelvingrove Bandstand is hosting some legends this week. A perfect summer evening of live music!

moments.title: UK Heatwave Continues
moments.blurb: A heatwave is gripping England and Wales, with temperatures expected to reach the mid-30s Celsius by mid-week, bringing warm and dry conditions.

angles.name: Stay Hydrated!
angles.copy: Another hot one today, and temperatures are set to climb even higher this week across England and Wales! Remember to stay hydrated and seek shade.

angles.name: Summer Sunshine
angles.copy: Sunshine and soaring temperatures are dominating the forecast this week! Perfect for enjoying the British summer, but keep cool out there.

moments.title: Drought Conditions & Hosepipe Bans
moments.blurb: Drought conditions persist across England, with eight water companies having implemented Temporary Use Bans (hosepipe bans) due to low rainfall and high demand.

angles.name: Water Saving
angles.copy: With ongoing drought conditions and hosepipe bans in effect across parts of England, every drop counts. How are you saving water this summer?

angles.name: Drought Impact
angles.copy: Low river flows and reservoir levels are a concern across England. Remember to check local restrictions and use water wisely.

moments.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Peak
moments.blurb: The annual Perseid meteor shower is set to peak around August 12-13, offering a spectacular skywatching opportunity under a new moon.

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Look up this week! The Perseid meteor shower peaks around August 12-13, with clear skies (hopefully!) offering a brilliant display. Fingers crossed for a good view!

angles.name: Wish Upon a Shooting Star
angles.copy: Ready for some cosmic magic? The Perseids are one of the best meteor showers of the year, and they're peaking soon. Get ready to make a wish!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Madonna
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Pop' Madonna turns 68 on August 16, continuing her reign as one of music's most influential and iconic artists. (Born 1958).

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna! What's your all-time favourite track from the Material Girl?

angles.name: Iconic Madonna
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has consistently redefined pop music and culture. Happy Birthday to a true legend!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, legendary guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12. (Born 1949).

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler! His distinctive guitar style shaped Dire Straits and influenced countless musicians. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Sultans of Swing
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to solo masterpieces, Mark Knopfler's music is timeless. Celebrating his birthday today!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: British new wave and jazz-rock artist Joe Jackson celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 11. (Born 1954).

angles.name: Steppin' Out
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! From 'Is She Really Going Out With Him?' to 'Steppin' Out', his music spans genres and generations.

angles.name: New Wave Maverick
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of Joe Jackson, a true new wave maverick who blended punk energy with jazz sophistication. A unique talent!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Michael Bublé
moments.blurb: Canadian crooner Michael Bublé celebrates his 51st birthday today, August 9. (Born 1975).

angles.name: King of Croon
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the one and only Michael Bublé! What's your favourite song from the smoothest voice in music?

angles.name: Feeling Good
angles.copy: Celebrating Michael Bublé's birthday today! His timeless voice and classic style make every day 'Feeling Good'.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Singer, songwriter, and actor Joe Jonas, known for his work with the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, turns 37 on August 15. (Born 1989).

angles.name: Jonas Brother Turns 37
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas! From boyband heartthrob to DNCE frontman, he's given us so many hits. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating Joe Jonas's birthday today! Still bringing the pop bangers. What's your go-to Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

moments.title: Ricky Gervais' Alley Cats on Netflix
moments.blurb: Ricky Gervais' new adult animated comedy series, 'Alley Cats', starring his voice alongside Diane Morgan, is set to stream on Netflix this August.

angles.name: Gervais' Feral Fun
angles.copy: Get ready for some feline chaos! Ricky Gervais' new adult animated comedy 'Alley Cats' is hitting Netflix this August. Expect outrageous mishaps and wild adventures!

angles.name: New Netflix Comedy
angles.copy: If you're a fan of Ricky Gervais, you'll want to check out 'Alley Cats' on Netflix this month. Perfect for a laugh-out-loud binge!

moments.title: Mo Gilligan's Big Chicken on Netflix
moments.blurb: Comedian Mo Gilligan embarks on a fried chicken diet across the UK and US to uncover its cultural history in the new Netflix documentary 'Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy', streaming this August.

angles.name: Fried Chicken Journey
angles.copy: Mo Gilligan on a fried chicken diet for a documentary? Count us in! 'Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy' is streaming on Netflix this August.

angles.name: Food Doc Alert
angles.copy: Ever wondered about the history of fried chicken? Mo Gilligan's new Netflix doc delves deep into the fast-food phenomenon. Grab a snack and tune in this August!

moments.title: Celebrity MasterChef Returns
moments.blurb: A new series of Celebrity MasterChef is returning to BBC One and iPlayer this summer, featuring new judges Giorgio Locatelli and Grace Dent.

angles.name: Kitchen Chaos
angles.copy: Celebrity MasterChef is back on BBC One this summer! Get ready for new judges Giorgio Locatelli and Grace Dent, and plenty of kitchen drama.

angles.name: Who's Cooking Up a Storm?
angles.copy: The heat is on! A fresh batch of celebrities are heading into the MasterChef kitchen this summer. Who do you think will impress the new judges?

moments.title: A House Through Time: Edinburgh
moments.blurb: Professor David Olusoga presents a new series of 'A House Through Time', exploring the history of a house in Edinburgh, coming to BBC Two this summer.

angles.name: History in Edinburgh
angles.copy: Professor David Olusoga returns with 'A House Through Time', this season exploring a fascinating Edinburgh property. Coming to BBC Two this summer!

angles.name: Scottish History Uncovered
angles.copy: Delve into the past with 'A House Through Time' as it uncovers the stories of a Scottish home. A must-watch for history buffs!
